server_name.description: The hostname, IP address, or socket path of the CUPS server.

default_user.description: The default username to use for authentication if not specified in the request.

encryption.description: The encryption level for the connection. One of: None, IfRequested, Required.

validate_certs.description: Whether to validate that the server's certificate Common Name matches the server hostname.

trust_on_first_use.description: Whether to trust new TLS certificates automatically upon first connection.

allow_any_root.description: Whether to allow TLS connections using certificates not signed by a trusted CA.

allow_expired_certs.description: Whether to allow TLS connections using expired certificates.

digest_options.description: HTTP Digest authentication options. One of: None, DenyMD5.

gss_service_name.description: The Kerberos service name used for GSS-API authentication.

user_agent_tokens.description: Which information to include in the User-Agent header. One of: None, ProductOnly, Major, Minor, Minimal, OS, Full.

ssloptions.description: A list of SSL/TLS options to apply (e.g., MinTLS1.2, MaxTLS1.3). Leave empty for defaults.
